speaker: margery_pell
text: 'Prentices, sweethearts, six lawyers out of term and a midwife. Fifty-two shillings in mine.

speaker: james_burbage
text: And the hush held. Two thousand at the messenger. I counted them as timber. That is a house. It is not a receipt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fifty-two is your stair, Margery. I will not turn it into the Rose's book, and I will not write a sum under the swan.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I never said it was the Rose. I said it was mine. The nuts are over the yard, and the trumpet was at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The hush held. Sincler came in black, and the yard stopped. That is the part of the afternoon I am keeping.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Keep the hush. Leave my timber alone. I have not sold a post today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The swan went up at noon. I am not writing a sum under it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then we are done. Fifty-two shillings, and the stair is clear.
